subject: Saving analysis results when closing R

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Saving analysis results when closing R
parts:
I got the following question by email, and I thought others might benefit by the question and my response.

If I ran the QTL analysis and then closed the window. Is there any way to go back and estimate effects and check additive effect  and use fit qtl with rerunning the entire analysis?

When you close R, it should ask "Save workspace image? [y/n/c]:"

If you respond "y", it will save all of the objects in your workspace, and so they'll be there when you run R the next time.

Within a session, you can use save.image() to save your workspace.

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Saving analysis results when closing R
parts:
There's not any way to rescue results, but you can save results as you go with save() or save.image(). Also see saveRDS().

karl
